modules.name: First Story (prologue)
modules.note: Always start a new campaign here.

steps.text: The game is built around 4 survivors: with fewer players, some control more than one
Each survivor: a gear grid with 1 Cloth and 1 Founding Stone, and a survivor record sheet
Name your survivor and record 1 survival; movement 5, other attributes 0; 1 armor point at the Waist for the Cloth
AI deck: Chomp, Size Up, Power Swat, Grasp, Maul, Terrifying Roar and Enraged shuffled facedown, with Claw on top
Hit location deck: shuffle all White Lion hit locations except Strange Hand, then put Strange Hand on top
Basic Action / Monster Reference card on the monster control panel
Showdown board out, record sheets and gear grids within reach
White Lion in the center; each survivor anywhere 6 spaces away (counted cardinally)
Shuffle the monster's hunt event cards; 1 facedown on every space marked E in its hunt board diagram
A basic hunt event card on every other open space except Start, Overwhelming Darkness and Starvation
Add any hunt event cards triggered by gear in your gear grids
Monster miniature on the space its level indicates; departing survivors on Start
AI deck: shuffle the monster's Basic, Advanced and Legendary cards separately and draw the numbers its story event gives for its level; shuffle those together
Its (S) cards and attribute tokens faceup on the monster control panel, with the Basic Action / Reference card
Shuffle all its hit location cards facedown
Shuffle the basic resource deck and the monster's own resource deck beside the panel
Terrain, monster and survivors on the showdown board as the showdown story event shows
The Founding Stone can be thrown from anywhere for an automatic critical wound, then it is archived
Pass the monster controller tile clockwise after every round
Choose a monster controller; they draw the top AI card - the White Lion's Claw
Play the hunt along the hunt board, then the showdown in rounds: monster's turn, then one act per survivor
